items.item_text: Minimum of 2 years of experience in a health care setting.

Venice Family Clinic is a leader in providing comprehensive, high-quality health care to people in need regardless of their ability to pay or personal circumstance. The organization has more than 500 staff who serve 45,000 people with compassion, dignity and respect across the Westside of Los Angeles, Inglewood, the South Bay and everywhere in between. We have a network of clinics, Early Head Start centers, and mobile clinics plus an expansive street medicine program to reach people experiencing homelessness. Read more about us at venicefamilyclinic.org.

Come join our Venice Family Clinic’s Centralized Referral Team and make a difference in the communities we serve as a Referral Coordinator. The Centralized Referral Team processes referrals to specialty care, diagnostics, DME, and other services. Duties include requesting authorizations for the referrals that are needed, acting as a liaison for patients and clinicians related to specialty care referrals, facilitating communication with referring clinicians, referring patients to appropriate resources, and providing follow-up (through phone, portal, and established communication systems).
Familiarity and knowledge of standard office equipment, electronic health records, and software products to perform administrative work.
Ability to establish and maintain and productive working relationships with clinicians, staff and patients from various social, cultural and economic backgrounds.
Attention to detail; ability to prioritize and multi-task assignments with competing demands.
Excellent organizational skills to complete work in a timely and efficient manner.
Ability to schedule patient appointments using computerized scheduling system.
Familiarity and knowledge of authorization process & managed care programs
Strong written and verbal communication skills in both English and Spanish.
